area: game performance: the victory frame wrote the profile twice; now once

find.report_claim: cycles 141-152 all claimed determinism was untouched, and the soak harness reports per-chunk frame timings; nobody had looked at whether any single frame exceeded a sane budget
find.live_evidence: a 20000-frame soak showed one chunk peaking at 10.98 ms against a 0.28 ms mean; per-frame timing pinned it to frame 2485, exactly the victory frame, and instrumentation counted TWO ProfileStore.save calls on that frame (4.63 ms + 4.85 ms), while sim.step was 0.68 ms and _sync_scene 0.16 ms
find.consumer_evidence: the two writes were _record_progress (wave bests, triggered by the wave event) and _record_campaign_clear (the win run) firing in the same update, so the most celebratory moment of a run paid two fsync-backed atomic saves out of a 16.7 ms frame budget

read: shooter/profile.py ProfileStore.save (temp + fsync + atomic replace under an advisory lock)
tests/test_history.py and tests/test_win_history.py for direct _finish_run expectations
killed: deferring all saves to the end of update() with a dirty flag: several tests call _finish_run() directly and then reload the file, so a deferred save would break the durability contract they encode
skipping the campaign-clear save instead: that is the write that must not be lost
dropping the fsync or the atomic replace: that would trade durability for latency on player data
analyze.survivor: extract the win condition into _campaign_win_reached(), use it in both the update loop and _record_progress, and let the progress save defer to the run record that follows in the same frame so the two mutations land in one atomic save

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py adds _campaign_win_reached() as the single predicate for sealing the campaign, uses it in update() and in _record_progress(), and _record_progress now saves only when the campaign is not about to clear; tests/test_win_history.py gains a test that drives the real bot run to the victory frame and asserts exactly one profile write, plus the win run and bests in the saved file, and a second test that a non-winning wave still saves immediately

shooter.soak: 20000 frames, identical determinism hash 55c614b52c4888b58212fb81e2e3c8c3 before and after (wave 4, 30 kills, score 11560, hp 38, alive, dropped_sfx 0); victory chunk [2400,3000] max step 10.98 ms -> 6.78 ms; worst chunk overall now frames 600-1200 at 7.89 ms instead of the victory frame
shooter.mutation: restoring the unconditional save in _record_progress made the new test report 'the victory frame performed 2 profile writes, expected 1'; shooter/game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 match)
shooter.gates: 5/5 (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, test, mechanics) after regenerating .aikit/codebase_map.md
